title: Spatio-Temporal Audio Language Modeling for Dynamic Sound Sources
abstract: arXiv:2606.14141v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sound events have semantic identities, locations, and trajectories, yet existing audio-language models typically encode clips as global event content. Conversely, sound event localization models track source directions over time but offer limited semantic coverage for language reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce ST-AudioQA, a spatio-temporal audio QA dataset and benchmark built from first-order ambisonic (FOA) renderings of static and moving sound sources. Each scene provides source identity, activity, direction, distance, and motion metadata, enabling dense trajectory supervision and QA about what is sounding, where it is, how it moves, and how sources relate. We further introduce ST-Audio Encoder, which jointly learns event semantics and time-resolved source trajectories, and ST-AudioLM, which exposes these audio tokens to an LLM for spatio-temporal audio QA. translated_title: 面向动态声源的时空音频语言建模
translated_abstract: 声音事件具有语义身份、位置和运动轨迹，然而现有的音频-语言模型通常将音频片段编码为全局事件内容；相反，声音事件定位模型虽然能够随时间追踪声源方向，但其语义覆盖范围有限，难以支持语言推理。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 ST-AudioQA，一个基于静态和移动声源的一阶高保真立体声（FOA）渲染构建的时空音频问答数据集与基准。每个场景都提供声源身份、活动状态、方向、距离和运动元数据，从而支持密集的轨迹监督，以及关于“什么在发声、它在哪里、它如何移动以及声源之间如何关联”的问答。我们进一步提出了 ST-Audio Encoder，联合学习事件语义和随时间变化的声源轨迹；以及 ST-AudioLM，将这些音频 token 输入大语言模型以进行时空音频问答。实验表明，这种表示改进了平衡……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于FOA渲染的时空音频问答数据集ST-AudioQA及配套的ST-Audio编码器和ST-AudioLM模型，联合建模声源语义与随时间变化的声源轨迹，使大语言模型能够回答关于声源身份、位置和运动的时空音频问答问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ST-AudioQA, a spatio-temporal audio QA dataset and benchmark built from FOA renderings, together with ST-Audio Encoder and ST-AudioLM that jointly learn event semantics and time-resolved source trajectories, enabling LLMs to answer spatio-temporal audio questions about source identity, location, and motion.
